name: suggested-choice-dialog
title: Suggested choice dialog
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A confirm dialog whose suggested radio starts selected. radio-cards remains the large option cards.

meta.descriptionEs: Un diálogo de confirmación cuya opción sugerida empieza seleccionada.

api.name: options
api.description: Mark one suggested. It is selected when value is omitted.

api.name: fields
api.description: Extra selects. Confirm waits until each has a value.

api.name: onConfirm
api.description: Called with the choice and the field values.

docs: Independent implementation of a common dashboard pattern. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
